metadata_only_differences: Descriptive metadata, environment verification flag and documentation finalized after recording. Instruction and simulation code/plan are unchanged.

visual_review.method: Native rear demo frames at 0, 5, 9, 13, 16 and 24.5 s; native front Dream frames at 0, 15, 30 and 50 s; final geometry and source-verified trace replay.
visual_review.demo: Both hands lift opposite clasp ends around the wrist form, align and close the pin catch, then release. The bracelet remains wrapped around the supported form, with the underside clear of the supports.
visual_review.dream: Completes the full action budget but does not grasp or close the clasp. The band remains in its initial layout.
visual_review.limitations: Coarse flexible band and idealized grasp capture; geometric pin alignment and simplified latch. No calibrated spring or finger-friction model.
